title: Revisiting semiclassical scalar QED in 1+1 dimensions
summary: We study the backreaction of a charged scalar quantum field in the presence of two opposite charges placed at the boundaries of a finite one-dimensional region, with attention to boundary effects. We review, correct, and extend previous corresponding work of Ambjørn \& Wolfram \cite{ambjorn_properties_1983}. Despite notable differences, our analysis confirms the mechanism, discussed by Ambjørn \& Wolfram, by which the incorporation of backreaction avoids certain instabilities.
